fr_html: Sauf rédaction et l'addition éventuelle d'une disposition tirée de son avant-projet, il propose l'adoption de la première partie de l'article 2 du projet Root—Phillimore.
en_html: He proposed that the first part of the second Article of the Root—Phillimore plan should be adopted, subject to redrafting and to the possible addition of a clause taken from his draft plan.
